plain: Hard-shadow Buttons now compress on hover and press (the face moves down onto a smaller edge) instead of growing downward; no code change needed unless you set --hds-hs or --hds-ty yourself.

steps.plain: Button hover moves the face down 1px onto a 2px edge and press moves it down 3px onto a 0px edge; remove any custom hover lift you added to match the old 4px hover edge.
